LightningComponentBundle.description: Dynamic matrix/pivot table component. Displays intersection values for row-grouped and column-grouped fields from any Salesforce object. Configured via ReportMatrixConfiguration__mdt records.

property.name: configName
property.label: Configuration Record Name
property.description: DeveloperName of the ReportMatrixConfiguration__mdt record that defines the matrix view (e.g. CountryRegistrationStatusMatrix)
